sources.title: MiniMax H3 LoRA — Categories, Settings & Where to Find Them
sources.snippet: How to Use a MiniMax H3 LoRA Download the open H3-Base weights (FL2VA and/or Ref2VA) from Hugging Face. See the MiniMax H3 Download guide. Verify the LoRA's stated base model. FL2VA LoRAs and Ref2VA LoRAs are not interchangeable. In ComfyUI, connect the checkpoint into a LoRA Loader node and load the LoRA at the recommended strength.
